svg.title: Blue Green Red II, 1965 — interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Two large opposing half-ellipses touch near the center over a red field. Approximate curves; the museum-partner source image is not colorimetrically measured.
svg.metadata: Primary record: https://art.seattleartmuseum.org/objects/14331/blue-green-red-ii; visual reference: https://www.artsy.net/artwork/ellsworth-kelly-blue-green-red-ii; reviewed 2026-10-27; hand-authored interpretive study, not a facsimile; approximate geometry and standardized screen colours.
